programme.title: Tar
programme.desc: Lydia Tar is an iconic musician, considered one the greatest living composer-conductors. This film examines the changing nature of power, its impact, and durability in our modern world.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: As war rages in Europe, a Nazi-scalping squad of American soldiers, known to their enemy as The Basterds, is on a daring mission to take down the leaders of the Third Reich.

programme.title: Anemone
programme.desc: A man treks into the woods of northern England to reconnect with his hermit brother. Decades old events left their bond fractured, and the past still lingers between them.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Forced into slavery by the corrupt heir to the throne, Roman general Maximus becomes a gladiator. His prowess in the arena leads him to Rome, the Colosseum, and a showdown with the new emperor.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Archaeologists awaken an Egyptian priest mummified alive 36 centuries ago for killing Pharaoh Seti and sleeping with his mistress. When he escapes from the tomb, he becomes a threat to the world.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Five friends who reunite in an attempt to top their epic pub crawl from 20 years earlier unwittingly become humankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: An apocalyptic zombie uprising gives Shaun and his mates a night from hell when they meet at the local pub and find themselves fighting off hordes of the brain-hungry undead in this horror comedy.

programme.title: Pineapple Express
programme.desc: A pothead who sees a crooked cop committing a murder goes on the run with his dealer. Seth Rogen and James Franco light up a weed-fuelled riot in this comedy from Judd Apatow and the Superbad team.

programme.title: Freaky Tales
programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise Of Cobra
programme.desc: In Kazakhstan, a convoy carrying advanced nanotech warheads is attacked. Rescued by an elite military unit, two soldiers join the team as they track a criminal group behind the assault, uncovering a deeper conspiracy.```

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The G.I. Joes are not only fighting their mortal enemy Cobra; they are forced to contend with threats from within the government that jeopardise their very existence.

programme.title: Eddington
programme.desc: During the COVID-19 pandemic, a standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbour is pitted against neighbour in Eddington, N.M.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: The lead-footed crew reunites in this turbo-fuelled tale of the vengeful brother of an international terrorist who sets his bloody sights on the boy racers that took his sibling down.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: After Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider, he gains newfound, spider-like powers and ventures out to save the city from the machinations of a mysterious reptilian foe.

programme.title: The Ballad Of Wallis Island
programme.desc: Old tensions resurface when former bandmates who were former lovers reunite for a private show at the island home of an eccentric millionaire.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: When Ryan believes he's uncovered a Russian terrorist plot to collapse the United States economy, he goes from being an analyst to a spy, fighting to save his own life and those of countless others.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: A teenager moves with his mum from New Jersey to California and struggles to fit in. After clashing with a local group led by a confident rival, he decides to learn karate to defend himself and build confidence.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Gentle soul Forrest Gump inoccently stumbles from one memorable experience into another through American history from the 1950s onwards, supported by his love for his childhood sweetheart, Jenny.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: Two guys accidentally meet an alien named Paul, who brings them on an insane road trip that alters their universe forever. They hatch a fumbling escape plan to return Paul to his mother ship.

programme.title: Ted
programme.desc: Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane brings his brazen humour to the screen when a grown man must deal with the loved teddy bear that came to life from a childhood wish and has refused to leave since.

programme.title: Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience
programme.desc: Featuring global K-Pop sensation Stray Kids, with a live performance from their record-breaking world tour and exclusive behind-the-scenes footage.
